t_advice_summary_textbox.text: There appears to be a pattern in relation to the colour of the baskets and the number of mushrooms you can collect.  Initially, it is thought that the yellow basket offers more mushrooms compared to the red basket.  Moreso there seems to be a pattern between the gnome with an orange hat and yellow basket and red hat gnome and red basket. It is a bit of trial and error and you may find that you need to pick an alternative colour basket.

vb_textbox.text: There appears to be a pattern between the colour of the gnomes hat and the colour of the basket.  Initially, it appears that the gnomes with the purple tall hat, blue tall hat and green short hat provides more mushrooms (be careful though, as midway through the game, these colours gave fewer mushrooms).  Try and work out the connection between the colour of the hats and the baskets.
